_doc: Line timing copied from another language's recording of the same song (user-authorized, 2026-10-09): the language's OWN recording is played at the other language's line times. from = the language whose line times are used; lines = 1-based lines (omitted: every line). Rows must be the same in both languages. Applies to 오리지널 송 / 어린이 노래 only.
